text:
sasha: Rainy day fashion show! Charlie in his yellow raincoat and a tiny rubber duck... I know, peak content. https://imgur.com/charlie-ducky :umbrella: :dog:
liam: OMG that's the happiest soggy boy :heart_eyes:
marie: send photo to my mom she will combust :joy:
michael: how do you dry him after walks? our lab smells like wet shoe forever...
sasha: I do 2x microfiber towels, then quick blow-dry on low while he sits on a towel. he tolerates it for treats :cookie:
liam: pro tip from groomer: use a hairdryer on cool about 6-8 inches away, keeps coat fluffy. `microfiber towel -> blow dry cool` works best.
marie: can confirm. add a rubber duck to distract and it's a 10/10 experience.
giphy-bot: *posts GIF of a corgi in raincoat* :rainbow:
sasha: posted a few more pics in #random-photos album — captioned "Charlie and the Great Rubber Duck Heist" :duck:
michael: rescue mission scheduled for Saturday. I'll bring towels :face_with_monocle:
liam: appointment to fawn over him at lunch? I'll bring treats :treat:
marie: voting yes. poll: who wants to be on Charlie duty? react with :raised_hands: if yes.
